verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships an official, first-party TypeScript plugin API: the obsidian-api repo exposes interfaces such as Vault for working with files and folders. Its developer docs cover building plugins in TypeScript, including a tutorial that compiles a sample plugin and loads it. A community user confirms using the API to extract metadata and publish metrics to CloudWatch. Missing for 10: SDKs in languages other than TypeScript, any SDK usable outside the running app (e.g., a programmatic client for external agents), and in-depth SDK reference coverage in the evidence.
